newsitem.title: USA: Georgia Gas acquires propane marketer.
newsitem.headline: Georgia Gas acquires propane marketer.

text.p: Georgia Gas Service Co said Friday it has agreed to purchase the outstanding stock of the Jordan Gas Propane Cos.
The acquisition will increase the sales of Georgia Gas Service Co's propane operations to more than 30 million gallons annually, the AGL Resources Inc subsidary said.
Jordan Gas Propane Companies sold more than 12 million gallons to 22,000 retail customers and more than 2 million gallons to wholesale customers in 1996.
